reports.title: Cedar River (above Nashua) (Floyd) fishing report
reports.text:
Black Crappie - Fair: Find crappie near snags in backwater areas. Try a small spinner, crankbait, or hook tipped with a minnow.
Smallmouth Bass - Excellent: Find smallmouth along rocky shorelines, current seams and limestone ledges as they move to deeper water. Try a jig tipped with soft plastics or nightcrawler.

reports.title: Lake Hendricks (Howard) fishing report
reports.text:
Black Crappie - Good: Anglers are using minnows fished under a bobber from shore or trolling a small crankbait.
Largemouth Bass - Slow: Toss a crank or spinner bait along a rocky shoreline or drop-off..

reports.title: Lake Meyer (Winneshiek) fishing report
reports.text:
Black Crappie - Slow: Find crappie in deeper water or near steep drop-offs. Try a small spinner or crankbait.
Largemouth Bass - Slow: Toss a crank or spinner bait along a rocky shoreline or drop-off.

reports.title: Turkey River (above Clermont) (Fayette) fishing report
reports.text: Smallmouth Bass - Good: Find smallmouth along rocky shorelines, current seams and limestone ledges as they move to deeper water. Try a jig tipped with soft plastics or nightcrawler.

reports.title: Upper Iowa River (above Decorah) (Winneshiek) fishing report
reports.text: Smallmouth Bass - Good: Find smallmouth along rocky shorelines, current seams and limestone ledges as they move to deeper water. Try a jig tipped with soft plastics or nightcrawler.

reports.title: Upper Iowa River (below Decorah) (Allamakee) fishing report
reports.text: Smallmouth Bass - Fair: Find smallmouth along rocky shorelines, current seams and limestone ledges as they move to deeper water. Try a jig tipped with soft plastics or nightcrawler.

reports.title: Alice Wyth Lake (Black Hawk) fishing report
reports.text: Black Crappie - Good: Try locating fish with a finder or fishing deeper portions of the lake using a live minnow under a slip bobber or jigging colored tube jigs or hair jigs.

reports.title: Cedar River (Nashua to La Porte City) (Black Hawk) fishing report
reports.text: Smallmouth Bass - Fair: Cast and retrieve jigs and plastics tipped with or without a half of nightcrawler. Crankbaits work well this time of year.

reports.title: Maquoketa River (above Monticello) (Delaware) fishing report
reports.text: Smallmouth Bass - Status Unsure: Cast and retrieve jigs and plastics tipped with or without a half of nightcrawler. Crankbaits work well this time of year.

reports.title: Wapsipinicon River (Tripoli to Troy Mills) (Buchanan) fishing report
reports.text: Smallmouth Bass - Status Unsure: Cast and retrieve jigs and plastics tipped with or without a half of nightcrawler. Crankbaits work well this time of year.

reports.title: Crystal Lake (Hancock) fishing report
reports.text: Black Crappie - Fair: Try small jigs and live bait in the dredge cuts.

reports.title: Big Hollow Lake (Des Moines) fishing report
reports.text: Black Crappie - Fair: Crappies are moving out to deeper water for the winter. Look for them along the edge of the trees on the south side of the lake across from the campground, campground kayak launch and fishing jetty.

reports.title: Lake Belva Deer (Keokuk) fishing report
reports.text: Black Crappie - Fair: Crappies are headed out to their deeper overwintering spots: the trees out along the olde creek channel.

reports.title: Lake Darling (Washington) fishing report
reports.text: Black Crappie - Fair: With the cold weather forecast, expect crappies to move out to their winter hides (ice fishing spots) in the lake.

reports.title: Lost Grove Lake (Scott) fishing report
reports.text: Black Crappie - Good: The cold weather is pushing the crappies out to deeper water for the winter.

reports.title: Lake Wapello (Davis) fishing report
reports.text: Largemouth Bass - Slow: Target the cedar tree piles with plastics.

reports.title: Rathbun Reservoir (Appanoose) fishing report
reports.text: Black Crappie - Slow: Target crappies around brush piles using small jigs.

reports.title: Lake Anita (Cass) fishing report
reports.text:
Black Crappie - Slow: Troll the roadbeds or fish along deep tree piles to find black crappies.
Largemouth Bass - Status Unsure: Bass anglers are finding fish in deep tree piles and along the roadbed.

reports.title: Prairie Rose Lake (Shelby) fishing report
reports.text:
Black Crappie - Fair: Find black crappies in the tree piles. Fish will average 9.5-inches.
Largemouth Bass - Fair: N/A

reports.title: Viking Lake (Montgomery) fishing report
reports.text:
Black Crappie - Fair: Catch 9-to-10-inch black crappies with minnows under a bobber around the deep tree piles.
Largemouth Bass - Slow: Boat anglers are finding largemouth bass in tree piles.

reports.title: Lake Macbride (Johnson) fishing report
reports.text:
Black Crappie - Fair: The bite has been inconsistent, with some days performing better than others. Most anglers are having success around brush piles or stump clusters using a minnow below a bobber, jigs tipped with minnows or plastics, or small ice jigs tipped with plastics or waxworms.
White Crappie - Fair: The bite has been inconsistent, with some days performing better than others. Most anglers are having success around brush piles or stump clusters using a minnow below a bobber, jigs tipped with minnows or plastics, or small ice jigs tipped with plastics or waxworms.

reports.title: Pool 12, Mississippi River (Dubuque) fishing report
reports.text: Black Crappie - Fair: Use a small jig and plastic combination or a live minnow rig in backwater areas with woody structure or along dying vegetation lines, or in side channels where there is a little bit of flow. Crappie should be staging to move into backwater areas as water temperatures drop.

reports.title: Pool 13, Mississippi River (Jackson) fishing report
reports.text:
Black Crappie - Fair: Use a small jig and plastic combination or a live minnow rig in backwater areas with woody structure or along dying vegetation lines, or in side channels where there is a little bit of flow. Crappie should be staging to move into backwater areas as water temperatures drop.
White Crappie - Fair: Use a small jig and plastic combination or a live minnow rig in side channel areas with woody structure. Crappie should be staging to move into backwater areas as the water temperature drops.

reports.title: Pool 14, Mississippi River (Clinton) fishing report
reports.text:
Black Crappie - Fair: Use a small jig and plastic combination or a live minnow rig in side channel areas with woody structure, or along dying lily pads in backwater areas.
White Crappie - Fair: Use a small jig and plastic combination or a live minnow rig in side channel areas with woody structure. Crappie should be staging to move into backwater areas soon.

reports.title: Pool 09, Mississippi River (Allamakee) fishing report
reports.text: Black Crappie - Fair: Crappie bite is improving. Use light tackle in 4-6 feet of water in trees and stumps in slight current.

reports.title: Pool 10, Mississippi River (Clayton) fishing report
reports.text: Black Crappie - Fair: Crappie bite is improving. Use light tackle in 4-6 feet of water in trees and stumps in slight current.

reports.title: Pool 11, Mississippi River (Clayton) fishing report
reports.text: Black Crappie - Fair: Crappie bite is improving. Use light tackle in 4-6 feet of water in trees and stumps in slight current.

reports.title: Black Hawk Lake (Sac) fishing report
reports.text: Black Crappie - Fair: Use a piece of crawler on a jig or a small minnow along the shore in Town Bay and near the inlet bridge area. Fish are up to 12-inches.

reports.title: Brushy Creek Lake (Webster) fishing report
reports.text: Black Crappie - Fair: Find crappie near submerged structure in 5-15 feet of water.

reports.title: Swan Lake (Carroll) fishing report
reports.text: Black Crappie - Fair: Target black crappie from the fish house and by the jetties this time of year. Most fish are 9- to 10-inches. Use a small jig tipped with a piece of crawler or minnow fished under a bobber from shore and from the jetties..

reports.title: Lake Miami (Monroe) fishing report
reports.text: Black Crappie - Slow: Target the cedar tree piles and other submerged structure with small jigs.

reports.title: Orient Lake (Adair) fishing report
reports.text: Black Crappie - Status Unsure: N/A

reports.title: Volga Lake (Fayette) fishing report
reports.text:
Black Crappie - Good: Find crappie around submersed or downed trees or logs. Try a small spinner or crankbait.
Largemouth Bass - Good: Toss a crank or spinner bait along a rocky shoreline or drop-off. Keep tension on the line to prevent losing your lure.

reports.title: Pool 15, Mississippi River (Scott) fishing report
reports.text: Smallmouth Bass - Fair: Throw inline spinners or crankbaits along rocky areas with some current/current breaks.

reports.title: Spirit Lake (Dickinson) fishing report
reports.text: Black Crappie - Good: Anglers are catching quality-sized fish..

reports.title: Pool 16, Mississippi River (Scott) fishing report
reports.text: White Crappie - Status Unsure: Try vertical jigging with minnows or floating minnows under a bobber around brush piles in the backwaters and side channels. Places to try are Sunset Marina and the Andalusia Island complex..

reports.title: Pool 17, Mississippi River (Muscatine) fishing report
reports.text: White Crappie - Status Unsure: Try vertical jigging with minnows or floating minnows under a bobber around brush piles in the backwaters and side channels. Expect the bite to pick up as water temperatures drop. Places to try are Big Timber or Cleveland Slough..

reports.title: Pool 18, Mississippi River (Louisa) fishing report
reports.text: White Crappie - Status Unsure: Try vertical jigging with minnows or floating minnows under a bobber around brush piles in the backwaters and side channels. Try crappie fishing in the Huron Island complex..

reports.title: Pool 19, Mississippi River (Lee) fishing report
reports.text: White Crappie - Status Unsure: Try vertical jigging with minnows or floating minnows under a bobber around brush piles in the backwaters and side channels.

reports.title: East Okoboji Lake (Dickinson) fishing report
reports.text: Black Crappie - Good: Anglers are targeting quality-sized fish.
